Risk title: Vessel EBITDA volatility remains above the multiple-expansion tolerance
Cause: OUTCOME DRIVERS (market/context): spot exposure, off-hire spikes, or segment-mix swings keep vessel EBITDA noisy versus multiple-expansion tolerance. TRIDENT-SIDE FAILURE MODES (actionable): (1) contract cover and spot mix not managed to an explicit volatility band; (2) off-hire spikes not root-caused into commercial and ops actions; (3) segment mix swings not stress-tested against earnings stability targets; (4) no early warning when EBITDA volatility breaches tolerance; (5) S&BD narrative assumes multiple expansion while earnings noise stays high.
Risk event: Period-to-period vessel EBITDA volatility exceeds the level assumed in the exit multiple story.
Consequences: Multiple support and planning confidence deteriorate.
Affected units: Commercial; Vessel Operations; Strategy & BD; Finance
Current mitigation: S&BD+Commercial+Finance: (1) set and manage contract-cover vs spot mix to an explicit volatility band (SBD-P05/P02/P09); (2) root-cause material off-hire spikes into Ops and Commercial actions; (3) stress-test segment mix against earnings-stability targets before shifts; (4) escalate when EBITDA volatility breaches the agreed tolerance; (5) condition multiple-expansion messaging on measured volatility improvement.
